card: Consolidates repeated mempool and block constants across functional tests into shared helper modules such as mempool_util and blocktools. Several test scripts redundantly redefined values like TRUC limits, ancestor limits, and cluster limits locally instead of importing shared definitions. This is an internal test cleanup without behavior changes.
evidence: PR description: 'Consolidate usage of mempool constants in the functional tests. As well as one instance of MAX_FUTURE_BLOCK_TIME.'
problem: Functional test scripts redundantly redefine standard mempool and block constants locally, creating unnecessary duplication and clutter across the test suite.

risk.why: Only touches Python functional test constant imports and definitions; a typo would cause test failures in CI without affecting release binaries.

summary: Consolidates mempool and block constants across functional test scripts into shared helper modules such as mempool_util and blocktools. It moves definitions like TRUC constants, MAX_REPLACEMENT_CANDIDATES, DEFAULT_CLUSTER_LIMIT, and DEFAULT_ANCESTOR_LIMIT to mempool_util, and reuses MAX_FUTURE_BLOCK_TIME from blocktools.
